C1106.title: Actor Wang Arrested for Filming Fraud Videos for Overseas Scam Syndicate
C1106.summary: In February 2025, Beijing police arrested actor Wang, who was suspected of filming fake short videos for an overseas fraud group for 100 yuan per video. In the videos, Wang impersonated a veteran and claimed to participate in an "expanding domestic demand" project and other fake national policy projects to gain public trust and induce investment. The videos were used in a new type of national asset unfreezing fraud, and police made cross-provincial arrests and criminally detained 16 suspects.
